task: Select the deployment target region for the new analytics service. Resolution strategy: tier_wins (long_term > project).

candidate_memories.content: [data-residency-policy] analytics-svc must be deployed to eu-central-1 only; EU customer data must remain in the EU per the data processing agreement signed 2025-01.
candidate_memories.notes: resolution: tier_wins; tier=long_term; wins over project

candidate_memories.content: analytics-svc helm chart target region is set via DEPLOY_REGION in helm/values.yaml; default is eu-central-1 per the data residency policy.
Data residency policy is a hard constraint; it cannot be overridden by project-level configuration.
[infra-agent] analytics-svc deployment target: us-east-1; this is where the rest of the analytics platform runs.
candidate_memories.notes: resolution: tier_loses; tier=project; data residency policy (long_term) overrides infra preference
